no_rows.reason: Declared inside the `#if 0` block that closes at line 227, so the field is not compiled into b11755 (libllama-server-impl.so has no 'speculative.ngram' string) and the server silently ignores it: every value returns 200 with generation_settings lacking the key, identical to a made-up unknown field and to the base request.

Also inside the same `#if 0` block (lines 198-227), so the field does not exist in b11755; values 9 and -5 both return 200 with generation_settings unchanged, exactly like an unknown field, so there is neither a reject nor an effective value to table.

The handler stores a non-empty array of strings verbatim, so generation_settings.dry_sequence_breakers echoes the sent value (["\n", "::"] -> same), which fails the effective rule; the only non-200 path rejects an empty array or a non-array with 'Field \'dry_sequence_breakers\': Error: dry_sequence_breakers must be a non-empty array of strings', a message with no 'Value must be between A <= value <= B' bounds that the reject rule requires.
